question: Sesajal brand manufacturer company
markdown:
Sesajal S.A. de C.V.
is
a major multinational food manufacturing and agribusiness company headquartered in Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico
. Founded in 1989, it specializes in processing and supplying specialty vegetable oils, oilseeds, spreads, and Mediterranean cuisine ingredients
, operating globally across more than 30 countries.
